entities.summary: Rose Epstein Frisch was a pioneering American scientist in fertility and human development whose work was instrumental in the discovery of leptin. She researched infertility and discovered that low body fat is a contributing factor to infertility. Rose Frisch was a naturalists & biologists from The Bronx (1918-07-07, The Bronx–2015-01-30). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to environmental history.
